# Third-party components

| Component | Version | License | Used for |
|-----------|---------|---------|----------|
| [VST3 C API](https://github.com/steinbergmedia/vst3_c_api) (`vst3_c_api/`) | 3.7.x | BSD-3-Clause, see `vst3_c_api/LICENSE.txt` | Plugin interfaces |
| [stb_truetype](https://github.com/nothings/stb) (`stb/`) | 1.26 | MIT  | Font rasterization |
| [stb_image_write](https://github.com/nothings/stb) (`stb/`) | 1.16 | MIT | Editor snapshots in tests |
| [Instrument Serif](https://github.com/Instrument/instrument-serif) (`fonts/`) | Italic | SIL OFL 1.1, see `fonts/InstrumentSerif-OFL.txt` | Title |
| [Bebas Neue](https://github.com/dharmatype/Bebas-Neue) (`fonts/`) | Regular | SIL OFL 1.1, see `fonts/BebasNeue-OFL.txt` | Numeric readouts |
| [IBM Plex Mono](https://github.com/IBM/plex) (`fonts/`) | Regular, Medium | SIL OFL 1.1, see `fonts/IBMPlexMono-OFL.txt` | Labels |
